h2. Description

*List's column choice must be kept for the user after logging out and back in, as it is today.* On the new build, a column turned off in List comes back after the next sign-in.

For example,
* a user turns a column off in the *Work Orders* List through *Column Selection*
* the column disappears, as expected
* the user logs out and signs in again, and the column is back in List

This appears inconsistent with S5-R8 of the PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options" (version 64), under *Epic SV-10043*. Production keeps the choice.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then click *List* in the display switcher (right of the toolbar).
# Click the *Column Selection* button (the columns icon next to the display switcher) and turn *Progress* off. Close the menu.
#* The *Progress* column disappears from the List.
# Click your initials (top right) and click *Logout*, then sign in again as the same user.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and *List*.
#* The *Progress* column is shown again, and *Column Selection* shows *Progress* turned on.
# Do steps 2–5 on production ({{app.shopview.com}}).
#* After signing in again, *Progress* is still off.

*Actual Result:*
* On staging, List's *Progress* column comes back after logging out and back in; the choice is not kept.

*Expected Result:*
* List keeps the column choice after logging out and back in, as production does today. As the test expects: *"Steps 18, 20 and 23: List keeps its own columns: Service Advisor on and Progress off."*
